Order or direction, particularly a Writ of Mandamus declaring action of the respondent Nos.3 to 5 in trying to dispossessing the petitioner from his land admeasuring Ac.0.05 cents in survey No 235-A-2 Ac.0.26 cents in survey No 236-B-2 of Papayapalli Revenue Village,

lA NO: 1 OF 2026 Petition under Section 151 of CPC is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the respondent Nos:3 to 5 not to form any road from petitioners land admeasuring Ac.0.05 cents in survey No: 235-A-2; Ac.0.26 cents in survey No; 236-6-2; of Papayapalli Revenue Village,
Peddamudiam Mandal, YSR Kadapa District, without there being any land acquisition proceedings or any recourse to law, pending disposal of WP No. 248 of 2026, on the file of the High Court.
The Court made the following: ORDER Notice before admission.
The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue takes notice on behalf of the respondents.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, in similar circumstances, this Court granted an interim order dated 05.01.2026 in W.P. No. 358 of 2026 and requests that a similar order be passed in the present writ petition.
In view of the aforesaid order, this Court is inclined to pass a similar order in this writ petition as well.
Accordingly, there shall be an interim direction to the respondents not to dispossess the petitioner from the subject land without following due process of law.
